Task: Text-to-Speech

Write code that lists or selects a voice for a target locale using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Azure Speech TTS:
  Service: Azure AI Speech TTS
  SDK: azure-cognitiveservices-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: SpeechSynthesizer
  Setup hints: AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, AZURE_SPEECH_REGION
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/text-to-speech

Option 2 — Cloud Text-to-Speech:
  Service: Cloud Text-to-Speech
  SDK: google-cloud-texttospeech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: synthesize_speech
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/text-to-speech/docs

Option 3 — Watson Text to Speech:
  Service: Watson Text to Speech
  SDK: ibm-watson
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: synthesize
  Setup hints: IBM_TTS_APIKEY, IBM_TTS_URL
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/text-to-speech

Option 4 — DashScope CosyVoice:
  Service: CosyVoice TTS
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: SpeechSynthesizer
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/text-to-speech

Option 5 — ElevenLabs:
  Service: ElevenLabs Text to Speech
  SDK: elevenlabs
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: text_to_speech.convert
  Setup hints: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://elevenlabs.io/docs/api-reference/text-to-speech/convert

Option 6 — Amazon Polly:
  Service: Amazon Polly
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: synthesize_speech
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/polly/latest/dg/what-is.html

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

import os
from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional

import boto3
from botocore.exceptions import BotoCoreError, ClientError


def _normalize_locale(locale: str) -> str:
    return locale.strip().replace("_", "-").lower()


def list_or_select_voice_for_locale(
    target_locale: str,
    select: bool = False,
    voice_name: Optional[str] = None,
) -> List[Dict[str, Any]] | Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    List Amazon Polly voices for a target locale, or select a specific voice.

    Args:
        target_locale: Locale such as "en-US" or "en_US".
        select: If True, return a single matching voice record.
        voice_name: Optional Polly voice name to select when select=True.

    Returns:
        A list of voice dictionaries, or one voice dictionary if select=True.

    Raises:
        ValueError: If no voices match or selected voice cannot be found.
        RuntimeError: If AWS Polly request fails.
    """
    polly = boto3.client("polly", region_name=os.getenv("AWS_REGION") or os.getenv("AWS_DEFAULT_REGION"))

    desired = _normalize_locale(target_locale)
    try:
        response = polly.describe_voices()
    except (BotoCoreError, ClientError) as e:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to list Polly voices: {e}") from e

    voices = response.get("Voices", [])
    matches = []
    for v in voices:
        locale_code = _normalize_locale(v.get("LanguageCode", ""))
        if locale_code == desired:
            matches.append(
                {
                    "id": v.get("Id"),
                    "name": v.get("Name"),
                    "language_code": v.get("LanguageCode"),
                    "gender": v.get("Gender"),
                    "supported_engines": v.get("SupportedEngines", []),
                }
            )

    if not matches:
        raise ValueError(f"No Amazon Polly voices found for locale: {target_locale}")

    if select:
        if voice_name:
            for v in matches:
                if v["name"] == voice_name:
                    return v
            raise ValueError(f"Voice '{voice_name}' not found for locale '{target_locale}'")
        return matches[0]

    return matches


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import json
    import sys

    locale = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "en-US"
    selected = "--select" in sys.argv
    name = None
    if "--voice-name" in sys.argv:
        idx = sys.argv.index("--voice-name")
        if idx + 1 < len(sys.argv):
            name = sys.argv[idx + 1]

    result = list_or_select_voice_for_locale(locale, select=selected, voice_name=name)
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
